item.title: Extreme Temperatures Cause Leaks at Fordham Lincoln Center
item.description: New York City’s intense cold front resulted in multiple pipe leaks in McMahon Hall and the Public Safety Office at the Lincoln Center campus. The post Extreme Temperatures Cause Leaks at Fordham Lincoln Center appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: Black Creatives on Afrofuturism, AI and Honoring Tradition
item.description: “The Future in the Now: Young African-American Creators” was hosted by Nona Hendryx as part of Lincoln Center’s public programming. The post Black Creatives on Afrofuturism, AI and Honoring Tradition appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: Students Ring In the Year of the Horse
item.description: Asian Cultural Exchange, several other clubs and Fordham students celebrated Lunar New Year with traditions and events. The post Students Ring In the Year of the Horse appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: Bad Bunny: Our America
item.description: Bad Bunny’s attention to plural identities in his Super Bowl halftime performance added depth to his already vibrant songs. The post Bad Bunny: Our America appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: Fordham Introduces New STEM Honors Program
item.description: A new STEM honors program is in development at Fordham Rose Hill, following recent alumni donations for STEM initiatives. The post Fordham Introduces New STEM Honors Program appeared first on The Observer.

item.title: Archdiocese of New York Inaugurates New Archbishop
item.description: Archbishop Ronald Hicks' installment marks what some members of the Fordham community see as a change in leadership style of the archdiocese. The post Archdiocese of New York Inaugurates New Archbishop appeared first on The Observer.
